company.name: Deed
company.shortDescription: Deed provides a social impact platform to connect people with causes and businesses with social impact.
company.description: Deed’s SaaS platform makes it easy for employees to donate to their favorite charities and volunteer with good causes. HR and social impact teams at companies like Airbnb and Stripe use Deed to increase employee engagement and retention. It was founded by Deevee Kashi, Steven Liu, and Aske Ertmann, and has offices in Brooklyn, Berlin, Tel Aviv, and San Francisco.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $10,000,000, or 78.13% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $10,727,350 to $63,774,251, a 5.95x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
